# Derivation populations

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.ts from packages/core/methods/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs`. -->

Where each index in ISAT was developed, as reported in its original paper. "Place" is the study centre. Most papers do not report ancestry.

- Most indices come from single cohorts, mostly in Europe or the USA, with a few hundred people or fewer. Their behaviour in other populations has often not been studied.
- Compare values within your own study rather than with values or thresholds from other populations.
- In genetic or epidemiological work, account for ancestry in the analysis (for example genetic principal components or stratification), not by changing the index.
- Insulin assays differ between laboratories, so values from different studies are only approximately comparable.

The same information is shown with every result and on the [Methods page](https://sufyansuleman.github.io/isat/#/methods) of the web app.

## Fasting

| Index | Population | N | Place | Original paper |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HOMA-IR | 12 adults without diabetes (aged 23-67) and 11 with type 2 diabetes; numbers differed between comparisons | 23 |  | Matthews 1985 |
| QUICKI | 28 non-obese, 13 obese and 15 type 2 diabetes; checked in a further 35 at another centre | 56 | National Institutes of Health, USA | Katz 2000 |
| FIRI | Adults without diabetes (13 in the minimal-model comparison) and 30 with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes | 13 + 30 |  | Duncan 1995 |
| Raynaud index | Adults and adolescents without diabetes aged 11-73, BMI 17-43: 22 normal weight, 48 overweight; half women | 70 |  | Raynaud 1999 |
| ISI basal | Pima or Tohono O'odham Indians of the Gila River Indian Community (clamp subgroup size not stated; 1,731 for diabetes incidence) | not stated | Arizona, USA | Hanson 2000 |
| Fasting insulin-to-glucose ratio | Pima or Tohono O'odham Indians of the Gila River Indian Community (clamp subgroup size not stated; 1,731 for diabetes incidence) | not stated | Arizona, USA | Hanson 2000 |
| Belfiore ISI (basal) | No single cohort: the reference means are the average of the normal groups in six published studies. The paper advises each laboratory to use its own normal reference values | 6 studies |  | Belfiore 1998 |
| Avignon Sib (Si0) | Adults: 31 normal glucose tolerance, 10 impaired glucose tolerance, 6 type 2 diabetes | 47 | Montpellier, France | Avignon 1999 |

## Lipid & body measures

| Index | Population | N | Place | Original paper |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revised QUICKI | Young, healthy, non-obese adults, 17 of them with a first-degree relative with type 2 diabetes | 57 | Milan, Italy | Perseghin 2001 |
| McAuley index | Adults aged 25-68 with normal glucose | 178 | Dunedin, New Zealand | McAuley 2001 |
| TyG index | Apparently healthy adults aged 18-65 (compared with HOMA-IR, not a clamp) | 748 | Durango, Mexico | Simental-Mendía 2008 |
| TG/HDL-C ratio | Overweight adults (BMI 25 or more) without diabetes | 258 | Stanford, California, USA | McLaughlin 2003 |
| Visceral Adiposity Index | Healthy non-obese adults; then tested in 1,498 primary-care patients | 315 | Palermo, Sicily, Italy | Amato 2010 |
| Lipid Accumulation Product | US adults in NHANES III (survey-weighted, multi-ethnic) | 9,180 | USA | Kahn 2005 |
| Adipo-IR | Adults with normal glucose tolerance, impaired glucose tolerance or type 2 diabetes | 302 | San Antonio, Texas, USA | Gastaldelli 2017 |
| Belfiore ISI(FFA) | No single cohort: the reference means are the average of the normal groups in six published studies. The paper advises each laboratory to use its own normal reference values | 6 studies |  | Belfiore 1998 |
